purpose: Evaluate the corrected real-frequency ECF-shape detector without reusing the legacy empirical-residue benchmark contract.

scenarios.null_gaussian: Stationary N(0, sigma^2). Primary threshold-calibration law and evaluation null.
scenarios.null_student_t: Stationary Student-t(df=5), rescaled to sigma. Tests false alarms under a stable non-Gaussian shape.
scenarios.shape_student_t: Gaussian before the change; Student-t(df=4), rescaled to the same standard deviation, after the change.
scenarios.shape_skew: Gaussian before the change; standardized skew-normal(shape=8) after the change, preserving sample mean 0 and standard deviation sigma in the post-change segment.
scenarios.mean_shift: Gaussian throughout with post-change mean +1.5 sigma and unchanged variance. Specificity/control scenario.
scenarios.variance_shift: Gaussian throughout with post-change standard deviation 1.75 sigma and unchanged mean. Specificity/control scenario.

evaluation.null_metric: Series-level probability of at least one alarm after score calibration.
evaluation.pre_change_metric: Series-level probability of at least one alarm after calibration but before the known change point.
evaluation.power_metric: Probability of at least one alarm from the change point through change_point + post_change_horizon.
evaluation.delay_metric: Observation delay of the first qualifying post-change alarm, conditional on detection.
evaluation.intervals: Wilson 95% confidence intervals for rates; median and interquartile range for conditional delay.

publication_screen.note: Prospectively fixed screening criteria for a scientific-method performance claim; failure does not imply the software has no utility.
